title: srs-context must be memory agents can trust is current (2026-10-30)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Let's update srs-context.

This repo should act as our main agent shared memory. It shouldn't really get out of date.

How do we make it work as something that agents can trust is current?

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-30; recorded verbatim. At that moment the session's brief reported the main srs-context clone 16 commits behind origin/main: a stray finding file (already rescued to origin as finding-7f5236df by the 2026-10-29 dream) was left in the main checkout, which stops the SessionStart hook fast-forwarding.
